dek.en: Custom AI chips, memory listings, and new datacenter deployments keep demand pointed upward, but today's constraints are physical: power, water, labor, packaging, and policy. The supply chain is still expanding, yet the bottlenecks are moving outside the chip itself.
dek.zh: 自研AI芯片、存储上市安排和新数据中心部署仍在推高需求，但今天的约束更偏物理层面：电力、水资源、劳动力、封装和政策。供应链仍在扩张，只是瓶颈正从芯片内部转向芯片之外。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: DeepSeek Develops Its Own AI Chip, Sources Say
title.zh: 消息称DeepSeek正在开发自研AI芯片

summary.en: Reuters reports that China's DeepSeek is developing its own AI chip, according to sources. The move points to a direct effort to reduce reliance on Nvidia accelerators as export controls and supply allocation shape China's AI compute stack. The candidate does not include performance, foundry, or schedule details, so this is a strategic signal rather than a product-launch story.
summary.zh: Reuters援引消息人士称，中国DeepSeek正在开发自研AI芯片。这个方向直指降低对Nvidia加速器的依赖，也反映出口管制和供给分配正在重塑中国AI算力栈。候选信息没有披露性能、代工厂或量产时间，因此它更像战略信号，而不是产品发布。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: South Korea's $880 Billion Chip and AI Plan Hits Power and Water Limits
title.zh: 韩国8800亿美元芯片与AI计划遭遇电力和水资源约束

summary.en: South Korea's 1,350 trillion won, or roughly $880 billion, chip and AI build-out faces major power and water challenges, Tom's Hardware reports. The plan combines a $520 billion semiconductor program with AI datacenter and robotics spending, mostly in corporate capex. A single megacluster could require a quarter of Seoul's total power demand, which makes grid and water infrastructure as important as fab shells and tools.
summary.zh: Tom's Hardware报道，韩国总额1,350万亿韩元、约8800亿美元的芯片与AI建设计划面临显著电力和水资源挑战。该计划包括5200亿美元半导体项目，以及AI数据中心和机器人相关投资，主体是企业资本开支。单个巨型集群可能消耗相当于首尔总用电量四分之一的电力，说明电网和供水基础设施已经与厂房和设备同样关键。

title.en: Spirit Electronics Offers Managed Access to U.S. Advanced Manufacturing
title.zh: Spirit Electronics为航天国防项目提供美国先进制造对接服务

summary.en: Spirit Electronics announced managed access to U.S.-based advanced semiconductor manufacturing for aerospace and defense programs, according to SpaceNews. The material point is supply-chain assurance: defense customers want domestic routing, qualification support, and traceable manufacturing paths for advanced components. It is narrower than a new fab announcement, but it fits the reshoring layer where procurement and trusted access matter.
summary.zh: SpaceNews报道，Spirit Electronics宣布为航天和国防项目提供美国本土先进半导体制造的托管对接服务。其核心并不是新增产能，而是供应链可信度：国防客户需要本土路径、认证支持和可追溯的先进器件制造流程。这个消息范围比新建晶圆厂更窄，但对应的是美国半导体回流中的可信采购层。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix Launches Reported $28 Billion U.S. ADR Listing
title.zh: SK hynix据称启动280亿美元美国ADR上市安排

summary.en: SK hynix launched a reported $28 billion U.S. ADR listing to ride the AI memory boom, according to the candidate headline. The listing would broaden U.S. investor access to the HBM and DRAM upcycle without changing wafer supply by itself. The useful signal is market structure: memory exposure is becoming a more direct public-market trade on AI infrastructure demand.
summary.zh: 候选标题称，SK hynix启动规模约280亿美元的美国ADR上市安排，以承接AI存储热潮。该安排本身不会改变晶圆供给，但会扩大美国投资者对HBM和DRAM上行周期的直接参与。这里的信号在于市场结构：存储正在成为押注AI基础设施需求的更直接公开市场标的。

title.en: SEMI Warns the White House on Memory Intervention
title.zh: SEMI就存储干预向白宫发出警告

summary.en: SEMI warned the White House about memory intervention, eeNews Europe reports. The sparse candidate does not specify the policy lever, but the timing matters because HBM, DRAM, and advanced packaging supply are already central to AI infrastructure allocation. Any intervention in memory markets risks spilling into equipment demand, customer qualification, and global capacity planning.
summary.zh: eeNews Europe报道称，SEMI就存储领域干预向白宫发出警告。候选信息没有说明具体政策工具，但时点重要，因为HBM、DRAM和先进封装供给已经是AI基础设施分配的核心变量。任何针对存储市场的干预，都可能外溢到设备需求、客户认证和全球产能规划。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Merck Korea Says Materials Move From Support Role to Lead Role
title.zh: Merck Korea称半导体材料正从配角走向主角

summary.en: Merck Korea says semiconductor materials are shifting from supporting roles to leading roles, according to The Elec. That framing is credible in advanced nodes and packaging, where dielectric, photoresist, cleaning, and interface materials can decide yield and reliability. The story is not a capacity announcement, but it captures why materials suppliers are gaining strategic weight in the equipment stack.
summary.zh: The Elec报道称，Merck Korea认为半导体材料正在从辅助角色转向主导角色。在先进制程和先进封装中，这一判断有现实基础：介电材料、光刻胶、清洗材料和界面材料都可能决定良率与可靠性。它不是产能公告，但说明材料供应商在设备链条中的战略权重正在上升。

title.en: Packaging PDKs Emerge as a Co-Packaged Optics Bottleneck
title.zh: 封装PDK成为共封装光学的缺失环节

summary.en: SemiWiki argues that the packaging PDK is the missing layer for co-packaged optics. As AI infrastructure pushes bandwidth, power, latency, and reach, optics is moving closer to the compute engine and photonic device performance alone is not enough. The practical bottleneck is design realization: electrical, optical, thermal, and package rules need to be captured in a usable kit before co-packaged optics can scale.
summary.zh: SemiWiki认为，封装PDK是共封装光学中缺失的一层。随着AI基础设施继续推高带宽、功耗、时延和传输距离要求，光学正在靠近计算引擎，仅靠光子器件性能已经不够。真正的工程瓶颈是设计落地：电、光、热和封装规则必须进入可用的设计套件，共封装光学才有可能规模化。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Worker Shortfall Threatens the U.S. Chip Factory Revival
title.zh: 劳动力短缺威胁美国芯片工厂复兴

summary.en: Bloomberg reports that a semiconductor worker shortfall is endangering the U.S. chip factory revival. The constraint sits outside lithography and process technology: new fabs still need technicians, construction labor, equipment engineers, and operations staff. For Intel Ohio, Micron New York, and other reshoring projects, workforce availability can become a schedule risk even when subsidies and capex are in place.
summary.zh: Bloomberg报道称，半导体劳动力短缺正在威胁美国芯片工厂复兴。这个约束不在光刻或制程技术内部，而在新厂所需的技术员、建设工人、设备工程师和运营人员。对Intel俄亥俄、Micron纽约以及其他回流项目来说，即使补贴和资本开支到位，劳动力供给也可能成为进度风险。

title.en: The Netherlands Looks to Move Past the Nexperia Dispute With China
title.zh: 荷兰希望翻过与中国的Nexperia争端

summary.en: A Dutch minister said the Netherlands wants to move past its Nexperia dispute with China, according to WDEZ. Nexperia is not an advanced-node story, but it is important in commodity, automotive, and industrial semiconductors where supply disruptions travel quickly through downstream production. A thaw would lower policy friction in a part of the chip chain that customers often notice only when it breaks.
summary.zh: WDEZ报道称，荷兰一名部长表示，荷兰希望翻过与中国围绕Nexperia的争端。Nexperia不是先进制程故事，但它在通用、汽车和工业半导体中很重要，这类供应中断会很快传导到下游生产。若关系缓和，将降低芯片链条中一个低调但关键环节的政策摩擦。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Micron and Chip Stocks Fall Despite Samsung Profit Surge
title.zh: 尽管Samsung利润增长，Micron和芯片股仍下跌

summary.en: Investor's Business Daily reports that Micron and broader chip stocks fell despite a Samsung profit surge. The reaction matters because it shows how much good memory news is already embedded in AI-infrastructure expectations. For investors, the bar is moving from earnings recovery to proof that HBM supply, margins, and end demand can keep compounding.
summary.zh: Investor's Business Daily报道称，尽管Samsung利润增长，Micron和更广泛的芯片股仍然下跌。这个市场反应重要，因为它显示AI基础设施预期已经吸收了大量存储利好。对投资者来说，门槛正在从盈利修复转向证明HBM供给、利润率和终端需求能够继续叠加。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: FuriosaAI's RNGD Accelerators Land in Equinix Lisbon Datacenters
title.zh: FuriosaAI的RNGD加速器进入Equinix里斯本数据中心

summary.en: FuriosaAI's RNGD accelerators have landed in Equinix's Lisbon datacenters, The Register reports. That clears the challenger bar because it is deployed silicon in a named datacenter footprint, not just a partnership announcement. The European beachhead gives the South Korean startup a proving ground for efficient inference against incumbent GPU deployments.
summary.zh: The Register报道称，FuriosaAI的RNGD加速器已经进入Equinix位于里斯本的数据中心。这个消息达到新势力板块的筛选标准，因为它是进入具名数据中心的实际硅片部署，而不是泛泛的合作声明。这个欧洲落点为这家韩国初创公司提供了一个与主流GPU部署对照的高效推理验证场。

theme.en: Inference Workarounds Move Closer to Hardware
theme.zh: 推理优化逼近硬件边界

dek.en: This research slate is about reducing the cost of moving, sampling, and waiting: MoE communication, VLA action caching, diffusion early exits, optical receivers, THz beamforming, and low-power control-channel monitoring. The strongest papers treat efficiency as a cross-layer problem rather than a model-only problem.
dek.zh: 今天的研究线索集中在降低移动、采样和等待的成本：MoE通信、VLA动作缓存、扩散模型提前退出、光接收机、THz波束成形，以及低功耗控制信道监听。最有价值的论文都把效率视为跨层问题，而不是单纯的模型问题。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Systems
title.zh: AI加速器与系统

title.en: Hardware-Aware Design Space Exploration for Mixed-Signal Spiking Neural Networks
title.zh: 面向混合信号脉冲神经网络的硬件感知设计空间探索

papers.authors: S. N. Chowdhury, V. Nair, T. Forhad, et al.

summary.en: Chowdhury et al. present an open-source hardware-aware framework for exploring mixed-signal SNN designs. It models LIF, Hodgkin-Huxley, and Axon-Hillock neurons plus floating-gate and ReRAM synapses inside a PyTorch training and inference loop. The useful contribution is cross-layer accounting: the framework reports accuracy together with area, power, and quantization sensitivity on benchmarks such as N-MNIST, DVS Gesture, and SHD. Caveat: it is a simulation and design-space tool, not measured silicon.
summary.zh: Chowdhury等人提出了一个开源硬件感知框架，用于探索混合信号SNN设计。它在PyTorch训练和推理流程中建模LIF、Hodgkin-Huxley、Axon-Hillock神经元，以及floating-gate和ReRAM突触。其价值在于跨层核算：框架在N-MNIST、DVS Gesture和SHD等基准上同时报告准确率、面积、功耗和量化敏感度。需要注意的是，这是一套仿真和设计空间工具，并非实测硅结果。

title.en: UBEP Re-architects Expert Parallelism for Production Superpods
title.zh: UBEP为生产级Superpod重构专家并行通信

papers.authors: Y. Liu, C. Liu, S. Shen, et al.

summary.en: UBEP targets the All-to-All communication path in MoE inference on high-bandwidth superpods such as NVIDIA NVL72/576 and Huawei CloudMatrix384. The paper attacks three bottlenecks: serialized BSP-style phases, synchronization overhead, and distance-agnostic token scheduling. It reports up to 52.4% lower All-to-All latency and up to 11.1% lower MoE inference time per output token. The result is important because sparse-model serving is increasingly limited by communication behavior, not just accelerator FLOPs.
summary.zh: UBEP面向NVIDIA NVL72/576和Huawei CloudMatrix384等高带宽Superpod上的MoE推理All-to-All通信路径。论文针对三个瓶颈：BSP式阶段串行化、同步开销，以及不考虑距离的token调度。作者报告All-to-All延迟最高降低52.4%，MoE推理的每输出token时间最高降低11.1%。这一结果重要，因为稀疏模型服务越来越受通信行为限制，而不只是受加速器FLOPs限制。

title.en: Circuits & Communications
title.zh: 电路与通信

title.en: Constellation Shaping for Complexity-Constrained Direct-Detection Optical Links
title.zh: 面向复杂度受限直接探测光链路的星座成形

papers.authors: R. Fischer, S. Chimmalgi, A. Rode, et al.

summary.en: Fischer et al. evaluate joint probabilistic and geometric constellation shaping with reinforcement learning for direct-detection optical signals. The demonstration is a simulated 56 GBd, 2.2 km C-band direct-detection system with complexity-constrained joint equalization and demodulation. The paper is relevant to short-reach optical links because receiver complexity is a hard deployment constraint, especially as bandwidth rises. Caveat: the reported evidence is simulation, so hardware margin and implementation cost still need validation.
summary.zh: Fischer等人评估了用强化学习进行联合概率与几何星座成形的方法，目标是直接探测光信号。论文展示的是一个仿真的56 GBd、2.2 km C波段直接探测系统，并约束联合均衡与解调复杂度。它与短距光链路相关，因为随着带宽提升，接收机复杂度会成为真实部署约束。需要注意的是，当前证据来自仿真，硬件余量和实现成本仍需验证。

title.en: Bending Beams for THz Wireless Networks With a Prototype
title.zh: 带原型验证的THz无线网络弯曲波束

papers.authors: A. Liu, X. T. Hu, W. Mei, et al.

summary.en: Liu et al. survey and prototype bending beams for THz wireless communication and sensing. These near-field beams are non-diffracting and self-healing, which could help THz links route around blockage. The paper compares beamforming design and hardware implementation methods, then presents a THz hardware demo that validates advantages over conventional beam focusing. The remaining challenges are practical: channel models, beam training, and codebook design are still early.
summary.zh: Liu等人系统梳理并原型验证了用于THz无线通信与感知的弯曲波束。这类近场波束具备非衍射和自修复特性，可能帮助THz链路绕开遮挡。论文比较了波束成形设计和硬件实现方法，并给出THz硬件演示，验证其相对传统聚焦波束的优势。剩余挑战仍偏工程化：信道模型、波束训练和码本设计都处于早期阶段。

title.en: MoE Reinforcement Learning for Energy-Efficient 5G PDCCH Monitoring
title.zh: 用于5G PDCCH节能监听的MoE强化学习

papers.authors: Y. Xiu, N. Wei, Z. Song, et al.

summary.en: Xiu et al. formulate 5G IoT-device PDCCH monitoring as a reliability-constrained energy minimization problem. The receiver decides whether to monitor the downlink control channel or sleep before it knows the actual scheduling outcome, while keeping missed-grant risk below a threshold. The MoE deep reinforcement learning setup matters because idle control-channel listening is a recurring energy drain in low-power radios. Caveat: the candidate abstract frames the method and objective clearly, but real-device silicon and RF-chain overhead are not established here.
summary.zh: Xiu等人将5G IoT设备的PDCCH监听建模为带可靠性约束的能耗最小化问题。接收机需要在不知道实际调度结果前，决定监听下行控制信道还是进入低功耗状态，同时把漏检授权的风险控制在阈值以下。MoE深度强化学习方案的意义在于，空闲控制信道监听是低功耗无线设备的长期能耗负担。需要注意的是，候选摘要清楚描述了方法和目标，但没有证明真实设备硅片与RF链路开销。

title.en: AI Research for Efficient Inference
title.zh: 面向高效推理的AI研究

title.en: ActionCache Accelerates Vision-Language-Action Models Without Training
title.zh: ActionCache无需训练加速视觉语言动作模型

papers.authors: R. Oi, H. Otsuka, K. Matsushima, et al.

summary.en: ActionCache reuses intermediate actions to warm-start flow-matching VLA models, reducing the iterative denoising cost in robotic manipulation. The method stores compact multimodal keys and retrieves similar past contexts across episodes or tasks. The paper reports up to 11.75x acceleration for pi_0.5 and 34.43x for GR00T-N1.6 while maintaining high task success in simulation and real-world settings. The hardware relevance is direct: lower denoising latency relaxes accelerator and edge-compute pressure for real-time robots.
summary.zh: ActionCache通过复用中间动作来热启动flow-matching VLA模型，从而降低机器人操作中的迭代去噪成本。该方法存储紧凑的多模态key，并在不同episode或任务之间检索相似上下文。论文报告在保持较高任务成功率的同时，pi_0.5最高加速11.75倍，GR00T-N1.6最高加速34.43倍，覆盖仿真和真实环境。其硬件意义很直接：降低去噪时延可以缓解实时机器人对加速器和边缘计算的压力。

title.en: Truncated Jump Sampling Cuts Diffusion NFEs Without Retraining
title.zh: Truncated Jump Sampling无需重训练降低扩散模型NFE

summary.en: Peng and Gao show that standard affine probability paths expose enough x0 information to early-exit an ODE sampler and decode the clean sample. Their Truncated Jump Sampling method needs no retraining, distillation, or architecture change. Across SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, and three class-conditional benchmarks, it reduces neural function evaluations by 20% to 70% with near-matched quality. The result is useful for inference systems because NFE count maps directly to serving cost and accelerator occupancy.
summary.zh: Peng和Gao指出，标准仿射概率路径在中间状态中已经暴露了足够的x0信息，可让ODE采样器提前退出并解码干净样本。他们提出的Truncated Jump Sampling不需要重训练、蒸馏或改变架构。在SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo和三个类别条件基准上，该方法将神经函数评估次数降低20%到70%，同时质量接近原始结果。这个结果对推理系统有用，因为NFE数量会直接映射到服务成本和加速器占用。

title.en: Quantum
title.zh: 量子

title.en: Entanglement as a Complexity Axis in Quantum Policies
title.zh: 作为量子策略复杂度轴的纠缠

papers.authors: J. Xu, D. Zeng, J. Paisley, et al.

summary.en: Xu et al. give a PAC-Bayesian account of generalization in parameterized quantum circuits used as policies and value functions. The key claim is that entanglement inflates the effective Fisher dimension, making connectivity a separate complexity axis from parameter count. In controlled experiments, more-entangled circuits show larger train-test gaps than non-entangled circuits with the same number of trainable rotations. This is a useful caution for quantum ML hardware and software co-design: more entanglement is not automatically better when sample efficiency matters.
summary.zh: Xu等人从PAC-Bayesian角度分析了作为策略和值函数的参数化量子电路泛化能力。其核心观点是，纠缠会放大Fisher几何的有效维度，使连接性成为独立于参数数量的复杂度轴。在受控实验中，纠缠更多的电路相较于可训练旋转数量相同的非纠缠电路，呈现更大的训练到测试间隙。这对量子ML软硬件协同设计是一个有用提醒：当样本效率重要时，更多纠缠并不自动等于更好。
